info.title: Chat runtime operational endpoints
info.description: P1 10단계. isolated Chat only; public ALB must deny metrics. Offline recovery is an explicit operator job followed by new Chat Tasks, not an HTTP endpoint or automatic reopen.

get.description: External storage failure alone does not change process liveness. No details.
Includes runtime gate, DB, Core auth, Task lease and prepared Redis transport/subscriptions. No details.
Separate service token only; end-user JWT is rejected. Blank token denies all collection. Internal scraper access only. No per-user/room/session labels. Requires CHAT_LIFECYCLE_ENABLED.

401.description: Missing/invalid dedicated service token; no metrics

metricsServiceToken.description: CHAT_METRICS_SERVICE_TOKEN, separate from JWT/Core/Redis credentials, 32-256 ASCII URL-safe characters; never supplied to FE.
